newsitem.title: ITALY: INA 1996 cons net profit up 22.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: INA 1996 cons net profit up 22.6 percent.

text.p: Italian insurance group INA on Tuesday reported a 22.6 percent rise in group 1996 consolidated net profits to 505 billion lire.

The group also said in a statement after a board meeting that the board had approved a proposal to participate in the recapitalisation of Banco di Napoli Holding SpA for up to one trillion lire from the current equity of 100 billion lire.

For 1997, the group said that results for the first four months of 1997 were superior to that forecast in the group's own budget, but added that results for the whole of 1997 could show a lower level compared to 1996 due to lower interest rates and lower financial margins.
In the first three months of 1997, INA said life premiums saw a rise of around 16 percent, while premiums from general business were static.
For 1996, INA group pretax profits were 1.003 trillion lire, up 23.5 percent from 812 billion lire in 1995, with premiums issued rising 1.6 percent to 6.651 trillion lire.
